Listen A data breach happens when personal information is accessed, disclosed without authorisation, or is lost. For example, when:a USB or mobile phone that holds a individual’s personal information is stolena database containing personal information is hackedsomeone’s personal information is sent to the wrong person.A data breach can harm an individual whose personal information is affected. They can, for example, suffer distress or financial loss.There are things you can do to reduce your risk of harm. And, there’s help available if you suffer distress.
